method: Poppler rendering and visual inspection of complete pages, supported by text extraction and catalogue comparison.
sourceCurrentness: Local PDF bytes match the recorded download hashes. The Ministry index was inaccessible during this pass; no live correction check is claimed.

reviewedPagesThisPass.disposition: Application details, fee, edit/fixation, permanent cancellation, final-admission warning. Editing and cancellation clarified in FAQ.
Category-specific documents and submission, annual parallel service-fee table, payment before registration. Source-linked FAQ added.
Fine arts: 50% and entrance pass; registration 4–12 October, exam 13 October 10:00, drawing pass 50/100. Existing exam conditions retained.
Damascus health-sciences assessments: 80% general, 70% parallel, 60% faculty-family, 50% equivalent/foreign; programme-specific assessments. Existing conditions agree.
Political science minima and required test agree with catalogues. Source conflicts on written/interview order; FAQ directs applicant to faculty confirmation.
Physical education 50%, pre-application medical/fitness assessment; registration and test windows checked. Existing conditions retained.
Music entrance assessment and 50% minimum; defence/security require their tests before listing choices. Existing conditions retained.
Female nursing schools: Syrian/equivalent, 2004 or later, fitness; accommodation only for single women if available. Applied-arts exams and vocational qualification scope agree with tables.
Idlib media and archaeology entrance assessments. Media names corrected. Male-only restriction remains on directing, consistent with separate choice rows and PDF 5 p3, not all media departments.
Tourism/hospitality entrance interview and language test; hospitality-certificate language-only exception. Existing assessment conditions retained.
Rail/oil medical and legal interview are after admission; non-attendance, written rejection and next-choice procedure. Separate Education Ministry tests and later-admission restriction added to FAQ.
Business, finance, digital administration, office, dental and engineering institute departments. No new independently scored choices.
Mechanical/electrical, medical equipment, communications, media, renewables and veterinary departments. Media exam and directing-only gender scope confirmed; repaired display labels.
Agriculture and related institute departments and temporary study locations. Department directory not expanded into choices.
Medical/midwifery, maritime, computing, statistics, guidance and translation departments. Female-only midwifery is department-specific; scientific math 60% and English 70% conditions already present.
Social service, archaeology, applied arts, printing/media and railway departments. Before/after-admission assessments and male-only railway rule agree.
Health and industrial institute departments. Chemical industries requires 140/200 chemistry, already represented as 70%.
Oil/gas, finance and legal institutes: male-only oil/gas, post-admission checks, Rmeilan location and separate Energy Ministry vocational competition. Existing rules retained.
Tourism/hospitality departments and entrance requirements; hospitality-certificate assessment differs. Existing qualification and assessment rules retained.
Sharia/Arabic institute locations and 60% religion requirement for academic certificates. Existing academic choices retained; Sharia holders follow direct registration.
Remaining Sharia/Arabic institutes; security institutes with programme-specific gender, birth from 1 January 2005 and admission tests. Existing route conditions agree.

Arab International University acting/film: academic 50%, vocational 55%, required entrance exam; registration 4–11 October, tests 10–14 October, programme-specific preparations. Existing choices; FAQ added.
Al-Manara acting: academic 50%, vocational 55%, entrance exam; registration 4–11 October and tests 10–14 October. Existing choices; FAQ added.
Continuation of support-directory page 1 plus Idlib, Hama and Tartous. Technical, disability and Arab/foreign centres remain distinct; linked official directory retained.
